# Three.js 0.186.0

Version pinned to 0.186.0 (r186), MIT license; see LICENSE.

Official upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r186

Unmodified browser distribution files:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.0/build/three.module.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.0/build/three.core.min.js

Both files are served locally. The minified core is saved as `three.core.js` to match the module's relative import; its contents are unchanged. No import map, external CDN request, npm installation or build step is needed to run the application.
